module_summary: Two-state Moore FSM: a 1-bit state register toggles between A and B based on input in, and out decodes state B.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 1-bit Moore state register (A/B), reset to B, next state chosen by input in.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state, high when state is B.

groups.name: fsm_controller
groups.description: Two-state Moore machine with next-state logic and decoded output out.
